request.style: English, bluegrass gospel, fast banjo rolls, mandolin chop, fiddle runs, dobro slides, upright bass, high lonesome tenor lead with tight three-part harmony on the chorus, driving and bright, 132 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The wind came howling off the hills
The waves broke over the side
The boat was filling fast with water
And the fishermen cried
But Jesus slept down in the stern
His head upon a pillow
Teacher, don't you care at all
We're going down below

[Chorus]
Quiet, be still, he said to the sea
And the wind lay down at his feet
Who is this man, who can this be
Even the wind and the waves obey

[Verse]
He rose and spoke into the gale
And all the storm was gone
The water lay as smooth as glass
Beneath the morning sun
Why are you so afraid, he said
Do you still have no faith
They trembled in the quiet boat
And looked into his face

[Chorus]
Quiet, be still, he said to the sea
And the wind lay down at his feet
Who is this man, who can this be
Even the wind and the waves obey
